**Volume:** T85

**Original Category:** 古逸部

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle anonymous Dūnhuáng-preserved text is a commentary on the *[Guān wú liàng shòu fó jīng](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0071)* (T0365), the *Visualization-of-Amitāyus Sūtra* — one of the *Three Pure Land Sutras*. Preserved in Taishō volume 85 (the *Dūnhuáng yíshū*).

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (500 – 900) reflects the broad Dūnhuáng-fragment composition period.

The Taishō text (T2760) is established on the Dūnhuáng manuscript.
